description: This PHP source file defines the class Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor_Array, which is part of the Image_Graph package. The class is used to map numerical values to array entries, acting as a data preprocessor in a graph rendering context. It includes a constructor to initialize the lookup array and a private method _process for converting a value using the array lookup.

classes.name: Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor_Array
classes.description: A class for formatting data based on an array lookup, enabling mapping of numerical data to string labels or other representations.

methods.name: Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor_Array
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class with a lookup array.

methods.name: _process
methods.description: Processes a value by returning the corresponding array entry if it exists, otherwise returns the original value.
